pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sellers_in_rj FROM sellers WHERE seller_state = 'RJ';

SELECT strftime(order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customers
FROM customers
GROUP BY customer_state
ORDER BY customers DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(item_count) AS avg_items_per_delivered_order
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
) t;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS pct_orders_paid_credit_card
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN payments p
  ON p.order_id = o.order_id AND p.payment_type = 'credit_card';

SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS five_star_reviews
FROM reviews
WHERE review_score = 5
  AND strftime(review_creation_date, '%Y') = '2017';

SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-07-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-08-01';

SELECT r.region, SUM(oi.price) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.state = c.customer_state WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-05-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-08-01' GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY gmv DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.seller_id) AS active_sellers_sp
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-06-02'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-09-01'
  AND s.seller_state = 'SP';

SELECT p.category_en, COUNT(*) AS items_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01' AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND p.category_en IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.category_en ORDER BY items_sold DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*)::DOUBLE, 0) AS late_rate FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND strftime(order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') = '2017-11';

SELECT AVG(date_diff('day', order_purchase_timestamp, order_delivered_customer_date)) AS avg_delivery_time_days
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-03-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-04-01'
  AND order_status = 'delivered'
  AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS low_ratings
FROM reviews
WHERE review_score <= 2
  AND review_creation_date >= DATE '2018-04-01'
  AND review_creation_date < DATE '2018-07-01';

WITH customer_orders AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS repeat_customer_pct
FROM customer_orders;

SELECT oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-02-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-02-01'
GROUP BY oi.seller_id
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT s.seller_state, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN o.order_id END)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS late_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_orders FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' GROUP BY s.seller_state HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 100 ORDER BY late_rate DESC LIMIT 1

WITH d AS (
  SELECT o.order_id,
         CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE)
              THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_time' END AS delivery_status
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.delivery_status,
       AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id) AS orders
FROM d
JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = d.order_id
GROUP BY d.delivery_status
ORDER BY avg_review_score;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT r.region AS region,
         p.category_en AS category_en,
         SUM(oi.price) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN regions r ON r.state = c.customer_state
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
    AND p.category_en IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.region, p.category_en
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT region, category_en, gmv,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY gmv DESC) AS rn
  FROM base
)
SELECT region, category_en, gmv
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY region, gmv DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'canceled'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01';

WITH per_customer AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id AS uid,
         MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_order_ts,
         BOOL_OR(strftime(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y') = '2018') AS ordered_in_2018
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM per_customer
WHERE strftime(first_order_ts, '%Y') = '2017'
  AND ordered_in_2018;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month,
         SUM(oi.price) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 1
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT month, gmv,
         LAG(gmv) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_gmv
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT month,
       gmv,
       ROUND(100.0 * (gmv - prev_gmv) / NULLIF(prev_gmv, 0), 2) AS mom_growth_pct
FROM lagged
WHERE month BETWEEN '2018-01' AND '2018-08'
ORDER BY month;

WITH order_paid AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS paid
  FROM payments
  GROUP BY order_id
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'voucher' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
)
SELECT AVG(paid) AS avg_paid_per_order
FROM order_paid;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_multiple_sellers
FROM (
  SELECT order_id
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) > 1
) t;

WITH sp_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
  WHERE s.seller_state = 'SP'
    AND o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT c.customer_state,
       AVG(date_diff('day', so.order_purchase_timestamp, so.order_delivered_customer_date)) AS avg_wait_days
FROM sp_orders so
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = so.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY avg_wait_days DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND p.category_en = 'health_beauty'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01';

WITH valid_2017 AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id, oi.price
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
),
seller_gmv AS (
  SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS gmv
  FROM valid_2017
  GROUP BY seller_id
),
top20 AS (
  SELECT seller_id, gmv
  FROM seller_gmv
  ORDER BY gmv DESC
  LIMIT 20
)
SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT SUM(gmv) FROM top20)
       / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(gmv) FROM seller_gmv), 0) AS top20_gmv_pct

SELECT AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score
FROM reviews r
WHERE r.order_id IN (
    SELECT oi.order_id
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
    WHERE s.seller_state = 'MG'
);

SELECT AVG(date_diff('day', order_purchase_timestamp, order_delivered_customer_date)) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01'
